 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Bipin Kumar, Advocate  For the State : Mr.Binod Kumar, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR

2. The present application has been filed for quashing the order dated 02.01.2021 passed by learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Begusarai by which cognizance was taken against the petitioner in connection with Begusarai Mufassil Police Station Case No. 655 of 2019 dated 12.12.2019 registered under Sections 409, 420, 465, 466, 467, 468, 469 and 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3.
Earlier the petitioner had given undertaking at the stage of bail that he will return the money but he has not returned the same.
Again he wants time to return the same.
4. Learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 has Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.22539 of 2024(2) dt.15-07-2024 opposed the prayer.
5. In view of the above, I do not find any merit in this application.
